statement: A general pencil of degree-4 plane curves has exactly 27 singular members, each counted once.

source.version: arXiv:0812.3354v3 (1 July 2019), primary PDF inspected 4 November 2026

scope: Singular members of a general projective pencil in the full space of degree-4 plane curves.
notes:
Specialize the discriminant-degree formula 3(d−1)² at d=4. General singular members are irreducible one-nodal curves.

The degree3(d−1)^2 is the classical homogeneous-discriminant formula attributed to Boole (GKZ, Chapter 1 Example 4.15 and Chapter 9 Example 1.6). Brugallé–Mikhalkin give a later floor-diagram verification. For monodromy records, this supplies only the discriminant degree/irreducibility; the separate sectional-monodromy argument supplies the group.
